Find applicable evidence-backed ways to reduce execution time in this GitHub Actions workflow. Consider its jobs, dependencies, commands, triggers, and repository manifests.
name: Changelog Bot Trigger

on:
  pull_request_review:
    types: [submitted]

permissions: {}

jobs:
  check:
    name: Check approved pull request
    if: >
      github.repository == 'openwisp/django-x509' &&
      github.event.review.state == 'approved' &&
      (github.event.review.author_association == 'OWNER' ||
        github.event.review.author_association == 'MEMBER' ||
        github.event.review.author_association == 'COLLABORATOR')
    concurrency:
      group: changelog-trigger-${{ github.repository }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
      cancel-in-progress: true
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Check for noteworthy PR
        id: check
        env:
          PR_TITLE: ${{ github.event.pull_request.title }}
        run: |
          if echo "$PR_TITLE" | grep -qiE '^\[(feature|fix|change!?)\]'; then
            echo "has_noteworthy=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          fi

      - name: Save PR metadata
        if: steps.check.outputs.has_noteworthy == 'true'
        env:
          PR_NUMBER: ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
        run: echo "$PR_NUMBER" > pr_number

      - name: Upload PR metadata
        if: steps.check.outputs.has_noteworthy == 'true'
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7
        with:
          name: changelog-metadata
          path: pr_number
          retention-days: 1

results.content:
Skip explicitly dispensable workflow runs

Pattern: P-LIT-SKIP-WORKFLOW (workflow_skip)

When is skip explicitly dispensable workflow runs applicable?

Assess skip explicitly dispensable workflow runs for this repository, preserve its required checks, and propose a minimal change or NO_CHANGE.

Preconditions: Repository policy permits a specific run to be omitted

Contraindications: Strict contract requires all triggers to execute

Method: Treat as behavior-changing rather than a safe default; Require evidence about affected checks

Reported finding: Explicit skipping has limited aggregate impact.

Reported metrics: {"comparison": "less_than", "paid_vm_time_reduction_upper_bound_percent": 0.1}

Source: Resource Usage and Optimization Opportunities in Workflows of GitHub Actions (2024), 4.2.4; Table 4; PDF pp. 7: https://software-lab.org/publications/icse2024_workflows.pdf

Literature example before:

# ANALYST ILLUSTRATION; NOT PAPER CODE; NOT EXECUTED
trigger CI for each submitted revision


Literature example after:

# ANALYST ILLUSTRATION; NOT PAPER CODE; NOT EXECUTED
omit a revision only under an approved skip policy
